A bounded part of the broader inline-expected-value cleanup: make Redisson database-index selection visible at the shared test assertions, preserving nullable expectations for versions without index support.

- **Assertions:** Replace the private helper calls with inline expectations, retaining `"0"` and the configured `"1"` where applicable:
  ```java
  equalTo(DB_NAMESPACE, hasDatabaseIndex() ? "0" : null)
  ```
- **Scope:** Remove only the private expected-value helpers; keep capability hooks and other test behavior unchanged.
- **Overlap:** PR #19204 also touches these test classes; its unmerged changes are not included here.

<!-- START COPILOT CODING AGENT SUFFIX -->



<!-- START COPILOT ORIGINAL PROMPT -->



<details>

<summary>Original prompt</summary>

> # Inline short Redisson namespace expectations
> 
> Implement this bounded portion of https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-java-instrumentation/issues/19984 and open one draft PR against main.
> 
> The user requested separate Copilot cloud coding-agent assignments and approved the short expected-value-helper cleanup. Conditional attribute-assertion-list rewrites are deferred. This task owns only Redisson namespace expected-value selection in two shared test classes.
> 
> ## Exact file allowlist
> 
> - `instrumentation\redisson\redisson-common-3.0\testing\src\main\java\io\opentelemetry\javaagent\instrumentation\redisson\AbstractRedissonClientTest.java`
> - `instrumentation\redisson\redisson-common-3.0\testing\src\main\java\io\opentelemetry\javaagent\instrumentation\redisson\AbstractRedissonAsyncClientTest.java`
> 
> Paths are repository-relative and use Windows separators from the coordinating session. Resolve them appropriately in your execution environment.
> 
> ## Change and boundaries
> 
> Replace `dbNamespace()` and `dbNamespace(databaseIndex)` at assertion sites with inline `hasDatabaseIndex() ? existingIndex : null` expectations. Preserve the existing `"0"` and `"1"` values at their respective sites. Remove only the unused private expected-value helpers.
> 
> Keep `hasDatabaseIndex()` and its subclass overrides. Do not inline mode-accessor implementations, change batch behavior or fixture setup, rewrite connection-URL helpers, or modify exact attribute checks, span order, production code, build scripts, metadata, or documentation. Do not rewrite conditional assertion lists or the established `experimental(value)` exception.
> 
> PR #19204 is still open and changes these test classes. This assignment is being submitted independently against current main despite that overlap; do not incorporate the other PR's unmerged code, merge it, or resolve its conflicts. Keep this PR's changes surgical and mention the known overlap as context. Recheck current main; the earlier inventory of 21 synchronous and five asynchronous call sites is a guide, not an edit quota.
> 
> Stay within the allowlist. Report an insufficient allowlist or incompatible upstream changes rather than expanding the assignment.
> 
> ## Acceptance
> 
> Follow repository instructions, apply the narrow affected Spotless task, and validate through concrete Redisson javaagent consumers of the shared tests. Cover versions with and without database-index support and the relevant latest-dependency variant using existing build tasks. Preserve nullable expected types and assertion overload selection.
> 
> Open one draft PR against main describing this as a partial cleanup related to #19984, without an automatic closing reference. Report validation and environment blockers accurately. Do not merge or post review comments.


</details>
